summary: Full E2E testing of Calendario module (backend + frontend). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed covering tipi CRUD (default 3 types, UUID assignment, 400 on empty), eventi CRUD (create/list by month/year, conteggio-mesi, update, delete, 400/404 edge cases), and home riepilogo 'calendario_mese' field. Frontend: all critical flows validated — Home tile (cta-calendario) navigates to /calendario, page renders mese-griglia with giorno-N cells, clicking a day opens EventoDialog with date prefilled (2026-10-20 verified), creating event shows chip in grid and row in elenco-eventi, clicking chip opens edit mode and update persists, delete uses custom ConfirmDialog (NOT window.confirm) and removes event, month navigation (prev/succ/select/oggi) works, select-mese shows counts in parentheses, Tipi dialog adds new type (TEST_Consegna) which appears in legenda-tipi and evento-tipi. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow, dots render instead of chips. All TEST_ data cleaned up and default tipi restored.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — minor a11y warning from Radix UI, not functional

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/calendario.py: GET /conteggio-mesi returns dict with int keys which JSON serializes as string keys — frontend accesses conteggi[i+1] where i+1 is number; works because JS coerces, but explicit casting would be clearer.
No input validation on 'data' field format (YYYY-MM-DD) — invalid date strings would be stored as-is. Consider adding regex validator in EventoIn.
No pagination on /calendario/eventi (hard limit 5000) — fine for cantiere scale but worth noting.
A11y: add DialogDescription to EventoDialog and TipiDialog to resolve Radix warnings.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed; all TEST_ events + TEST_Consegna tipo created and cleaned up via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendario module is fully functional. Default tipi (alaggio/varo/altro) have been restored after testing. If testing again, note that the public URL is in frontend/.env and login is just POST /api/auth/login {password:'admin'} which sets httpOnly cookie.
